The hexagon divides into six equilateral triangles whose sides each equal the hexagon's side length. Each triangle has perimeter 21, so its side is 7. The hexagon has 6 sides of length 7, so its perimeter is 42 inches.

Solution 1 wrongly sets P_t = P_h/6 and then derives 18s. Solution 2 wrongly says the triangle side is x/2. Solution 3 is correct.
